doctrine.name: THE RESILIENCE DOCTRINE
doctrine.law: Nothing in the open dies by accident; it only leaves by PROVEN identity-verified consent.
defends_against: ACCIDENTAL DEATH: Drive lockout, domain lapse, dead host — the work stays alive
IMPERSONATED REMOVAL: takedown only with proven standing from the rightful party
removability_ladder: our own archive.org items → we darken directly
Wayback captures → owner takedown request (honored, not instant)
truly-public + copied by others → beyond guarantee. PREVENTION > REMOVAL
doctrine.conditional_seal: privatepit / privateinform: seal follows CONTENT, not name. Concept-only state = archivable. The moment ANY real participant content exists → permanent seal. Any doubt → FAIL CLOSED, skip, ask.
doctrine.audit_tie_in: P.I.T. Protocol Stage 5 recurring audits now ALSO verify archive captures match current consent state (revocations propagate to the archive via the removability ladder).

crispness_standard.summary: A session is SUUUPER CRISP in the archive only when the RAW layers are captured, not just rendered HTML. Raw over rendered, always.
layers_required: L1 AUDIO — the exact playback bytes the transponder plays (64k mp3 on R2 or in-repo), byte-complete
L2 TRANSCRIPT RAW — plain-text transcript with segment timestamps [MM:SS] and its provenance header (model, language, transcription date, source video, Drive URL)
L3 WORD TIMING — word-level timing JSON where it exists (Deepgram nova-3 lane, e.g. shellpit data/nova3/*.json). This is the crispest layer; pits without it are crisp-L2 pending a nova-3 pass
L4 CATALOG — data/catalog.json (machine index binding audio ↔ transcript ↔ Drive origin ↔ quality/consent flags) + data/search-index.json
L5 MANIFEST + CONSENT — pit.json / pit.yaml (pit-manifest/0.1), consent.json, consent-ledger.json, any revocations file
L6 SITE MIRROR — the rendered experience (index.html + assets + thumbs/posters). Additive; NEVER a substitute for L1–L5
L7 ORIGIN POINTERS — original Drive video file ids recorded (capture of multi-GB originals = tier-2, size/consent permitting)
crispness_standard.practical_note: For every git-hosted pit, `git clone` of the repo captures L2–L6 in one move (full history included). L1 audio must ADDITIONALLY be pulled from R2 (enumerate media[].hosted URLs in each pit's data/catalog.json). Checksums: recommend sha256 sidecar per archive item (Archy-side).
